toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Styg' already means 'go higher', so 'styg hoër' is doubled; the meaning stays the same without it.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Styg' already says it goes higher; dropping 'hoër' keeps the meaning and leaves 'gewone termometer' intact.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Ná' meaning 'after' takes the acute accent so that it is not read as 'na' (towards).
toegepas.fout: Temporal 'na' lacks the accent in a lesson full of directional 'na'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Ná' marks 'after' and stops a reader taking it as 'towards'; meaning unchanged.

toegepas.blok: 'n Wind kry sy naam van waar hy vandaan kom
toegepas.na: Om die windrigting aan te dui, gebruik ons
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Vir die windrigting gebruik ons' is wooden; an om-te clause says clearly what the four directions are used for.
toegepas.fout: 'Vir die windrigting gebruik ons' is vague and wooden.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The om-te clause says plainly what the four directions are for, without adding content.

toegepas.blok: Die windkous wys waarheen die wind waai
toegepas.rede_vinder: A tube's openings are its 'ente'; 'kante' can be read as its sides.
toegepas.fout: 'Kante' of a tube can be read as its sides rather than its openings.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Ente' is the exact word for a tube's open ends; meaning unchanged.

toegepas.blok: Die windkous wys waarheen die wind waai
toegepas.rede_vinder: Matches 'ente' in the previous sentence: the wind enters at the wide end of the tube.
toegepas.fout: 'Wye kant' is imprecise for the open end of the tube.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Wye ent' is exact and matches the previous sentence.

toegepas.voor: en dit kom uit die weste
toegepas.na: en hy kom uit die weste
toegepas.rede_vinder: The lesson refers to the wind as 'hy' elsewhere ('waaruit hy waai'), so the pronoun should be consistent.
toegepas.fout: 'Dit' for the wind breaks the lesson's consistent 'hy' and could be read as the windkous.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Hy' points clearly to the wind, as the lesson does elsewhere.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Stop' sounds like speech for a line of liquid that reaches a mark; 'eindig' is the more natural written word.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Stop' is plain, natural wording for a Grade 5 reader; 'eindig' is only different.

laat_vaar.voor: wat buite in die oopte die reën opvang
laat_vaar.na: wat die reën buite in die oopte opvang
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: A definite object usually comes before the adverbials of place in a subordinate clause, so this order reads more naturally.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The original order reads well and stresses where the gauge stands; the reorder is lateral.

na_skrywer.na: kan meet hoeveel reën geval het
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'Hoeveel geval het' has no subject and reads incomplete; naming the rain makes the definition clear on its own.
na_skrywer.fout: The glossary definition 'hoeveel geval het' leaves the subject implicit and reads incomplete on its own.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: Adding a word rewords a glossary definition, which only the writer may change.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer
